name: Goblins Win!
summary: In Thousand Needles, a goblin race ticket pays off when the goblins come out ahead. A prize box comes back to whoever held the winning stub.

sections.title: The Goblin Ticket
sections.body: The goblin race ticket is the stub that counts when the goblins win. Hold on to it, and a goblin prize box is yours once the result is in. The gnome ticket has a result of its own, for the other side of the race.

faq.q: What is the Goblin Race Ticket?
faq.answer: It is the ticket for the goblin side of the race in Thousand Needles. It matters when the goblins win.

faq.q: What do you get when the goblins win?
faq.answer: A goblin prize box comes to whoever holds the goblin race ticket when the goblins come out ahead.

faq.q: What happens if the gnomes win instead?
faq.answer: Then the gnome ticket is the one that matters. Its result is called Gnomes Win!, the counterpart to this one.
